nodes.description: Private string state variable holding the token name 'BB Erzurumspor Token' in ERZToken.
Private string state variable holding the token symbol 'ERZ' in ERZToken.
Private uint8 state variable holding token decimals (2) returned by the overridden decimals() function.
Private uint state variable holding the initial supply 25000000000 minted to the deployer.
Public constant bytes32 role identifier keccak256('BURNER_ROLE') gating the burn() function.
ERC20 private mapping of address balances, mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
ERC20 private uint tracking total token supply, mutated by _mint and _burn.
ERC20 private nested mapping of owner-spender allowances, read in transferFrom and written in _approve.
AccessControl private mapping(bytes32 => RoleData) storing role membership and admin role.
AccessControl public constant bytes32 zero-value admin role granted to the deployer in the constructor.
ERZToken constructor: initializes ERC20 name/symbol, grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and BURNER_ROLE to msg.sender, mints initial supply.
Public burn(address,uint256) restricted to BURNER_ROLE holders; destroys tokens from an arbitrary address and emits Burned.
Overridden view function returning the ERZToken custom decimals value __decimals.
ERC20 internal function creating tokens, increasing _totalSupply and _balances and emitting Transfer from address(0).
ERC20 internal function destroying tokens, decreasing _balances and _totalSupply and emitting Transfer to address(0).
AccessControl internal function granting a role without any caller permission checks; should only be used during construction.
AccessControl public view function returning whether an account is a member of a role by reading _roles.
AccessControl private function setting _roles[role].members[account] = true and emitting RoleGranted.
AccessControl private function setting _roles[role].members[account] = false and emitting RoleRevoked.
AccessControl public function granting a role, guarded by onlyRole(getRoleAdmin(role)).
AccessControl public function revoking a role, guarded by onlyRole(getRoleAdmin(role)).
AccessControl public function allowing an account to revoke its own role, requiring account == _msgSender().
AccessControl internal view function reverting when the account lacks the role; used by the onlyRole modifier.
ERC20 public function transferring tokens from _msgSender() to recipient via _transfer.
ERC20 public function spending allowance to move tokens, reading _allowances and updating it in an unchecked block.
ERC20 public function setting an allowance for spender via _approve.
ERC20 public function atomically increasing a spender allowance.
ERC20 public function atomically decreasing a spender allowance with an underflow check.
ERC20 internal function moving balances, using unchecked subtraction of senderBalance and calling the transfer hooks.
ERC20 internal function writing _allowances[owner][spender] and emitting Approval.
Caller-controlled address used as the deployer, role holder and access-control subject throughout ERZToken and AccessControl.
Minting of __INITIAL_SUPPLY (25000000000) directly to the deployer inside the constructor.
Privileged destruction of tokens from any address passed as 'from' without any allowance or ownership check beyond BURNER_ROLE.
Granting DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and BURNER_ROLE to the deployer msg.sender via _setupRole, which performs no permission check.
Assembly of unchecked { balance - amount } subtractions in _transfer and _burn relying on prior require checks rather than compiler overflow guards.
Parameter 'from' of burn(address,uint256) identifying the address whose tokens are destroyed.
Parameter 'amount' of burn(address,uint256) specifying how many tokens are destroyed.
Parameter 'role' of hasRole(bytes32,address) identifying the role being queried.
Parameter 'account' of hasRole(bytes32,address) identifying the queried member address.
Parameter 'recipient' of transfer(address,uint256) receiving the tokens.
Parameter 'sender' of transferFrom(address,address,uint256) whose allowance and balance are spent.
Parameter 'spender' of approve/increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance receiving the allowance.
Local variable 'senderBalance' caching _balances[sender] before the unchecked subtraction in _transfer.
Local variable 'currentAllowance' caching _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] in transferFrom.
Empty ERC20 virtual hook invoked before every token transfer, mint and burn; a callback surface if overridden.
Empty ERC20 virtual hook invoked after every token transfer, mint and burn; a callback surface if overridden.

edges.reason: The deployer address msg.sender is used in the constructor to establish the initial privilege set.
burn() evaluates _msgSender() as the subject of the BURNER_ROLE membership check.
renounceRole requires account == _msgSender() before revoking the caller's own role.
msg.sender becomes the holder of DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and BURNER_ROLE through the unchecked _setupRole path.
BURNER_ROLE is passed as the role argument to hasRole in the burn() gate.
burn() calls hasRole(BURNER_ROLE, _msgSender()) and reverts when the caller is not a burner.
The role bytes32 parameter flows into the hasRole role lookup.
The account address parameter flows into the hasRole membership lookup.
hasRole reads _roles[role].members[account] from storage.
_grantRole writes true into _roles[role].members[account] after the hasRole check.
_revokeRole writes false into _roles[role].members[account] after the hasRole check.
_setupRole delegates directly to _grantRole without any caller permission validation.
The constructor calls _setupRole twice to bootstrap admin and burner privileges.
grantRole performs its own admin check and then calls the private _grantRole.
revokeRole performs its own admin check and then calls the private _revokeRole.
renounceRole calls _revokeRole to remove the caller's own role.
_checkRole uses hasRole to decide whether to revert for the onlyRole modifier.
DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE constant is granted to the deployer inside the constructor.
The constructor executes the role set-up operation that assigns privileged roles.
The constructor performs the initial token mint to the deployer.
__INITIAL_SUPPLY is the amount passed to the initial mint.
The initial mint credits the deployer balance in _balances.
The initial mint increases _totalSupply by the full initial supply.
The constructor invokes the internal ERC20 _mint routine.
burn() invokes the internal ERC20 _burn routine to destroy tokens.
burn() reaches the privileged destruction of tokens from an arbitrary address.
The burn 'from' parameter is the caller-supplied address being debited.
The burn 'amount' parameter is the caller-supplied quantity being destroyed.
The unvalidated 'from' address is forwarded directly into the burn operation and the Burned event.
The unvalidated 'amount' is forwarded directly into the burn operation.
_burn reduces the victim account's entry in _balances.
_burn reduces _totalSupply by the burned amount.
_mint increases the recipient's entry in _balances.
_mint increases _totalSupply by the minted amount.
_transfer debits the sender and credits the recipient in _balances.
_transfer performs an unchecked senderBalance - amount subtraction depending entirely on the preceding require.
_burn performs an unchecked accountBalance - amount subtraction depending entirely on the preceding require.
The cached senderBalance local feeds the require check and the unchecked subtraction in _transfer.
transfer() delegates the balance movement to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom() delegates the balance movement to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom() reduces the spent allowance by calling _approve inside an unchecked block.
currentAllowance caches _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] before the allowance check.
currentAllowance - amount is written back to the allowance mapping through _approve.
transferFrom reads the spender allowance from _allowances.
_approve writes the new allowance into _allowances[owner][spender].
The recipient parameter flows into transfer() and is forwarded to _transfer.
The recipient address is credited in _balances inside _transfer.
The sender parameter is the allowance owner and balance owner spent by transferFrom.
The sender address is debited in _balances inside _transfer.
The spender parameter becomes the allowance beneficiary written by _approve.
The spender parameter is used when increasing the allowance.
The spender parameter is used when decreasing the allowance.
approve() delegates the allowance write to _approve.
increaseAllowance() delegates the allowance write to _approve.
decreaseAllowance() delegates the reduced allowance write to _approve.
decimals() returns the stored __decimals state value.
__name is passed into the ERC20 base constructor when ERZToken is deployed.
__symbol is passed into the ERC20 base constructor when ERZToken is deployed.
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before balances are updated, an override point for reentrant behaviour.
_transfer invokes the _afterTokenTransfer hook after balances are updated.
_mint invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_mint invokes the overridable _afterTokenTransfer hook.
_burn invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before state updates.
_burn invokes the overridable _afterTokenTransfer hook after state updates.

normalization_plan.reason: The burn 'from' parameter only exists to supply the target address of the burn() function and should be folded into that core function node.
The burn 'amount' parameter only exists to supply the quantity of the burn() function and should be folded into that core function node.
The 'role' parameter is only meaningful as the lookup key of the hasRole core function node.
The 'account' parameter is only meaningful as the membership subject of the hasRole core function node.
The 'recipient' parameter is only meaningful as the destination argument of the transfer core function node.
The 'sender' parameter is only meaningful as the allowance owner consumed by the transferFrom core function node.
The 'spender' parameter is only meaningful as the allowance beneficiary of the approve core function node.
The senderBalance local is a temporary cache created inside _transfer and is meaningless outside that core function node.
The currentAllowance local is a temporary cache created inside transferFrom and is meaningless outside that core function node.
